# Golden input data for busbar-plugin-loader's own tests: the REAL on-disk names of the plugin
# artifacts the dlopen-seam tests locate. Each value must equal what that artifact's own build (or
# the oracle's fetch script) produces, or the test points at a file that does not exist. The loader
# names no instance; the tests read these names here, as data. One `key = value` per line; `#`
# starts a comment.

# The sibling `GetBusbar/<checkout>` repo whose release cdylib is the preferred kind:store fixture.
sibling_store_checkout = store-sqlite
sibling_store_plugin = store-sqlite-plugin
sibling_store_cdylib = busbar_store_sqlite_plugin

# The oracle cache's directory for the published store tarball (testing/shadow-oracle/fetch-plugin.sh
# <plugin-id> fills `plugins/<plugin-id>`).
published_store_plugin_id = store-sqlite

# The in-tree hermetic example cdylibs (crates/*-example-plugin), by their crate identifier.
store_example_cdylib = busbar_store_example_plugin
export_example_cdylib = busbar_export_example_plugin

# The REAL plugin repos that prove the secret and auth kinds (`src/tests/plugin_proof_tests.rs`;
# ci.yml `plugin-proofs` builds them into BUSBAR_PLUGIN_PROOF_DIR). The cdylib names are what those
# repos' own builds produce; the rest is what each plugin's own code answers.
proof_secret_cdylib = busbar_hashicorp_vault_plugin
proof_secret_config = {"addr": "https://127.0.0.1:9", "token": "busbar-proof", "timeout_secs": 2}
proof_secret_reference = kv/data/proof#field
proof_secret_resolve_error = request to Vault (https://127.0.0.1:9/v1/kv/data/proof) failed
proof_secret_refusal = hashicorp-vault plugin requires config (addr, token); none provided
proof_auth_cdylib = busbar_auth_github_plugin
proof_auth_redirect_uri = https://busbar.example/auth/token
proof_auth_config = {"client_id": "Iv1.busbar-proof"}
proof_auth_authorize_prefix = https://github.com/login/oauth/authorize?response_type=code&client_id=Iv1.busbar-proof&redirect_uri=https%3A%2F%2Fbusbar.example%2Fauth%2Ftoken&scope=
proof_auth_refusal = github plugin requires config (client_id); none provided
